532:t_1:89.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm doing it no matter what you say! Chances like this hardly ever come along!」

532:t_1:90.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Come on, $$アル$$! While $$宗介$$ isn't here...」

532:t_1:91.en:
$n
「$$クルツ$$... You'll have to beat me first.」

532:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「There it is. His hunter's smile is back after all this time.」

532:t_1:93.en:
$$クルツ$$
「W-What, $n?! You're getting in my way?」

532:t_1:94.en:
$n
「I won't stand here and let you do something $$千鳥$$ would hate.」

532:t_1:96.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(Is there a love triangle between $$宗介$$, $$かなめ$$, and $n...?!)

532:t_1:97.en:
$$クラン$$
(This is no time to be excited! That's insensitive, $$ミレーヌ$$!)

532:t_1:98.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Besides, it looks like the contest is already settled.)

532:t_1:99.en:
$$ランカ$$
($n... Does he still love $$かなめ$$ anyway...?)

532:t_1:100.en:
$n
「...Well, what will you do, $$クルツ$$? Let's fight barehanded, like men.」

532:t_1:101.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who'd want to brawl with you?! A pretty boy has neither money nor strength!」

532:t_1:102.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... You have no money, huh? You're getting more and more like me, $$クルツ$$.」

532:t_1:103.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't casually lump me in with you!」

532:t_1:104.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a strange one too, $n, protecting $$宗介$$ when you won't make a single cent.」

532:t_1:105.en:
$n
「That's what the spirit of volunteering means.」

532:t_1:108.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Everyone is talking. They say the one $n really loves is that person called $$かなめ$$.」

532:t_1:111.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(He seems seriously, totally, super serious!)

532:t_1:113.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So you do love her?」

532:t_1:116.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Um... $n loves $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, and $$宗介$$ loves $$かなめ$$, and $$かなめ$$ loves $$宗介$$...)

532:t_1:117.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Does this count as a love triangle too...?)

532:t_1:118.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$ was kind to me when I'd just transferred, and $$宗介$$ was my first friend at school...」

532:t_1:119.en:
$n
「So I absolutely want them both to be happy. I love seeing those two together.」

532:t_1:120.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So that's what you meant.」

532:t_1:122.en:
$$ティティ$$
「For now, it looks like everyone watching is relieved too.」

532:t_1:124.en:
$$クラン$$
「That's right. You have Miss $$スズネ$$, after all.」

532:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'll cheer you on too! $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$... and you, $n!」

532:t_1:128.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Someone falls in love with someone... It would be sad if that made someone else suffer.」

532:t_1:129.en:
$$アルト$$
「You seem calmer lately too, $$ランカ$$.」

532:t_1:132.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The human heart is fragile. The slightest trigger could make her unstable again, like she was before.」

532:t_1:134.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's wrong, Mr. Female Impersonator? It seems you made no progress while I was gone either.」

532:t_1:136.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... Don't push yourself. Paying off debts and romance both take steady little steps.」

532:t_1:137.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Rushing to find an answer won't do you any good.」

532:t_1:139.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I hear we're heading to $$新日本$$ on $$ゼロ$$'s instructions. Are we going to free that area from the Empire?」

532:t_1:141.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then what exactly are we going there for?」

532:t_1:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$スザク$$ told me we're headed for $$神根島$$.」

532:t_1:144.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, that's right. It's where $$ゼロ$$ settled things with $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$.」

532:t_2:6.en:
$$カレン$$
($$スザク$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$ aimed their guns at each other in front of this door...)

532:t_2:7.en:
$$カレン$$
(Thinking back, this was where $$ルルーシュ$$'s real battle began...)

532:t_2:8.en:
$$桂$$
「It's fine to reminisce, $$ゼロ$$... But tell us why you brought $c's members here.」

532:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I will have everyone here assist with my experiment.」

532:t_2:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Ideally, I would have liked the members in space and Japan to participate too.」

532:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why haven't you explained anything until now?」

532:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I want you to act naturally, with as few unnecessary preconceptions as possible.」

532:t_2:14.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Since you're using $c's members, does this have something to do with the $$烙印$$?」

532:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You are the $$特異点$$, $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$, after all... You're quick to understand.」

532:t_2:16.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm the other $$特異点$$, and I don't have a clue.」

532:t_2:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$オルソン$$ was held captive by $$サイデリアル$$... He probably has something in mind.)

532:t_2:18.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The $$烙印$$... It is the mark engraved on those whose fate is tossed about by $$時空震動$$s...」

532:t_2:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「But that's about the former $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ members, right?」

532:t_2:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s members, $$レド$$, $$テイタニア$$, and the others aren't involved, are they?」

532:t_2:21.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Neither $$ランカ$$-chan nor I are involved.」

532:t_2:22.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I'm afraid we can't say that anymore.」

532:t_2:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Given our transfer to the center of the galaxy, we can assume the $$烙印$$ is already engraved on all of $c and its allies.」

532:t_2:26.en:
$$レド$$
「Our fate will be tossed about by $$時空震動$$s too...?」
